FORM 4
 C.R.E. PAPER 2 MARKING SCHEME - 2026
1. a) Nathan’s prophecies about the messiah in 2 Samuel 7: 12-17. (7 marks)
 i. Messiah/King will be a heir descendant /lineage of David
 ii. God will ensure David kingdom last forever
 iii. The king messiah will save Israel from their nations
 iv. God will always support such a king/Messiah
 v. David kingdoms will remain strong for his sons
 vi. God would make David’s name great and bless his descendants
 vii. God would give Israel their own land
viii. Israel will live in peace during in peace during the reign of the king
 7 x 1 = 7mks
 b) Differences between the work of the John Baptist and that of Jesus Christ. (8mrks)
 i. John the Baptist preached mainly in the wilderness/ the desert of Judah, while Jesus preached in the
 synagogues/ homes/ cities/ towns/ temple
 ii. John the Baptist called people to repentance, while Jesus forgave/ died for their sins
 iii. John the Baptist was Baptist with water, but Jesus was baptized with the Holy spirit/ fire
 iv. John the Baptist lived the life of a Nazarite/isolated, while Jesus mixed freely with all people
 v. The emphasis of John the Baptist preaching was in the promised Messiah, while that of Jesus was about
 the kingdom of God
 vi. John the Baptist’s message was direct whereas Jesus preached in parables
 vii. While John the Baptist disciples fasted, the disciples of Jesus ate and drank
viii. John the Baptist did not perform miracles, but Jesus ministry was full of signs/ wonders
 ix. John the Baptist was the fore runner / prepared the way while Jesus fulfilled/ was the messiah
 4 X 2 = 8mks.
 c) Lessons do Christians learn from the temptations of Jesus in the wilderness? (5 Marks)
 i. Food and material possessions should not lead them to fall to sin
 ii. Only God alone should be worshiped
 iii. they should put their God into test
 iv. they should pray and fast for God guidance to overcome temptations
 v. when tempted should turn to bible for guidance
 vi. the holy spirit help them to overcome temptations
 vii. temptations strengthens their faith
 5 x 1 = 5mks
2. a) Reasons why Jesus choose the twelve disciples. (6 marks)
 i. In order to teach them the secrets of the Kingdom of God.
 ii. To have companions/personal assistants;
 iii. To form an inner grap which should assist him during his public ministry;
 iv. To be witnesses to his saving acts in the world;
 v. To reveal his person/give a new understanding of his messiahship;
 vi. It symbolized the reconstruction of the twelve tribes of Israel.
 vii. To train/prepare them for the mission after his death.
 viii. To lay a foundation for the establishment of the church.
 ix. To continue with the biblical theme of election in which God chooses anyone to serve him.
 6 X 1 = 6 mks
 b) Describe the incident in which Jesus healed the demonic man in Gerasene in Luke 8:26-39.
 (7marks)
 i. When Jesus arrived at Gerasene he found a man who was possessed.
 ii. The demonic man who wire no clothes and lived in the tombs.
 iii. When the man saw Jesus he fell before him shouting, don’t torment me the son of the most high.
 iv. Jesus commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man.
 v. Jesus asked him what is your name and the man replied Legion.
 vi. The demon repeatedly begged Jesus not to order them to go to the Abby’s.
 vii. They begged Jesus to let them to go the pigs who were nearby.
 viii. They entered to the pigs drown them into the sea/ocean/lake.
 ix. The pig’s attendants witnessed the incidents rushed to the town to tell what they had witnessed.
 x. When people came, found the man seated at Jesus feet, dressed and in his right of mind.
 xi. People were afraid.
 xii. People in the region asked Jesus to leave and he left.
 xiii. The healed man begged Jesus to go with him but Jesus asked him to go home and tell what God had
 done to him.
 7 X 1 = 7mks
 c) Ways through which the church continues with the healing ministry of Jesus.
 (7marks)
 i. Christians pray for/preach to the sick.
 ii. Laying hands on the sick/anointing them/any other miraculous healing.
 iii. Providing guidance and counseling service.
 iv. Constructing hospitals/health centers/rehabilitation centers.
 v. Providing protective/curative drugs/treating the sick.
 vi. Paying medical expenses for the sick
 vii. Producing/disseminating literature/electronic media on health issues.
 viii. Preaching against evil causes of ailments that interfere with good health.
 ix. Providing food/clothing/shelter/finances to the sick and needy.
 x. Visiting the sick
 xi. Training medical personnel
 xii. Educating through seminar/workshop
 7 X 1 = 7mks
3. a) Outline Jesus teachings on watchfulness and readiness, (Luke: 44-56). (7marks)
 i. Believers should be dressed for his coming;
 ii. They should keep their lamps burning;
 iii. They should be awake/alert;
 iv. Those who are found waiting
 v. They should be prepared at all times since they do not know the time for Christ’s coming;
 vi. Believers should continue working until Christ comes back;
 vii. The servants/believers who are drunkards/mistreat fellow workers will be punished;
 viii. Those who know what is required of them/their masters will and fail to do it will receive a severe
 beating;
 ix. Believers are expected to respond to God according to how much they have received from Him.
 Those who do wrong out of ignorance will receive lesser beatings/punishment.
 7 x 1 = 7mks
 b) Signs of the end times as taught by Jesus in Luke 21:5-38. (6marks)
 i. Strange things will happen to the celestial bodies/sun/moon/stars
 ii. People will come claiming to be messiah
 iii. There will be wars between nations
 iv. Natural calamities like earthquakes/roaring of the sea will occur
 v. The followers of Christ will be hated/persecuted
 vi. There will be famine/pestilences
 6 x 1 = 6mks
 c) Reasons why Christians should have faith in God. (7 marks)
 i. Gog fulfill his promises to human being through faith
 ii. Through faith in prayer Christians receive request from God.
 iii. They depend on god for all things.
 iv. Faith is a sing of commitment to God.
 v. Through Faith Christians Can perform miracles/ great things.
 vi. Through faith in God Christians are healed.
 vii. Faith helps Christians overcome temptations /challenges/persecutions.
 viii. Faith helps Christians to wait patiently for second coming of Jesus/kingdom of God
 7 x 1 = 7mks
4. a) Explain the teachings of Peter concerning the people of God. (1Peter 2:1-6). (6marks)
 i. The believers are chosen people/race/they have been selected.
 ii. They are a royal priesthood/they are to save the greatest King/God.
 iii. They are Holy nation/expected to lead holy/righteousness lives
 iv. They belong to God/they form a family of God’s own possession.
 v. They are to declare wonderful deeds of God/that is to lead a life of worshipping God/testifying
 about God.
 vi. They were called from darkness to light/their lives had been transformed and should not be
 dominated by evil.
 vii. They were once not a people/they were outside the covenant way of life
 6 x 1 = 6mks
 b) Ways in which the Holy Spirit was manifested on the day of Pentecost. (6marks)
 i. The disciples received the Holy Spirit in Jerusalem during the Pentecost.
 ii. A mighty wind was felt and filled the room.
 iii. Tongues of fire descended from heaven and rested on each disciples head.
 iv. The disciples spoke in tongues.
 v. Peter and the Disciples were filled with courage.
 vi. Prophecies were fulfilled i.e Prophecies of Joel.
 vii. People were baptized through the Holy Spirit.
 6 x 1 = 6mks
 c) Causes of disunity among the Christians in Kenya today. (8marks)
 i. Splinter groups formations.
 ii. Leadership wrangles.
 iii. Discriminations/tribalism/negative ethnicity.
 iv. Classism/different economic classes.
 v. Deity worship/ idolatry/sacraments.
 vi. Homosexuality /lesbianism /Gayism
 vii. Cultural differences.
 viii. Political interferences.
 8 x 1 = 8mks
5. a) Sources of Christian’s ethics. (5marks)
 i. Human reason/experience
 ii. The bible/ Sacred Scriptures/
 iii. Traditions from Christian community
 iv. Natural law.
 v. Situation ethics.
 vi. Community/Christian leader
 5 x 1 = 5 mks
 b) State the factors that have led to the misuse of drugs in Kenya. (8marks).
 i. Poor role models/ lack of role models
 ii. Stress/Depression/Rebellion
 iii. Peer pressure/Curiosity
 iv. Influence of mass media
 v. Availability/cheap cost of drugs/too much wealth
 vi. Irresponsible parenthood
 vii. Lack of guidance and counselling
 viii. Corruption/greed
 ix. Poverty
 x. Moral decay/permissiveness in the society
 xi. Lack of knowledge/ignorance on the use of drugs
 xii. Idleness/ unemployment
 xiii. Urbanization/western culture
 8 x 1 = 8mks
 c) Dangers of using illicit drugs among the youths in Kenya. (7marks)
 i. There is an increase in rate of crimes committed
 ii. Leads to sexual immorality/ STI and STDs
 iii. Leads poverty due misuse of resources.
 iv. Leads to damage of vital organs of the
 Download thisbody.
 v. Leads to indiscipline in institutions of learning.
 vi. Leads to increase in street families/children.
 vii. Leads to family breakups/quarries.
 viii. Leads to murder/deaths.
 7 x1 =7 mks.
6. a) Reasons why laws are important in Kenya. (6marks)
 i. Laws safeguards peoples’ rights/citizens’ rights
 ii. They protect consumer from exploitation.
 iii. Peoples property is protected under law
 iv. It allows for economic development/growth
 v. It allows individuals to enjoy freedom of worship
 vi. It acts as a check/measure of those in authority
 vii. It outlines how foreigners should be handled
 viii. The control taxation/collection of revenue
 ix. Protect citizens from oppression/protection by government
 x. They determine punishment for crime/prevent crime
 xi. They ensure political stability in Kenya/nation
 xii. They outline relationship between Kenya and other nations
 6 x 1 = 6mks
 b) Methods used in disciplining errant members in traditional African communities.
 (7marks)
 i. Paying fines.
 ii. Denying children food for some time.
 iii. Wrong doers./ Reprove/Reproach
 iv. Giving unpleasant names to reflect the wrong that the person has done
 v. Denying culprits access to social occasions / being detained / isolation.
 vi. Summoning an indiscipline member before the council of elders.
 vii. Excommunicating wrong doers from the community.
 viii. Through caning and beating.
 ix. Disowning by parents / relative / friends.
 x. Being cursed by elders,
 xi. Refusing to name children after them.
 7 x 1 = 7mks
 c) Obstacles to effective maintenance of law and order in Kenya today. (7marks)
 i. There is an increase in the rate of crime / the law enforcement officers cannot cope with the work
 load. Due to unequal distribution of resources,
 ii. Permissiveness in the society.
 iii. Due to political instability / incitement by politicians,
 iv. Extreme poverty.
 v. Social discrimination.
 vi. Some cultural beliefs / practices hinder effective maintenance of law.
 vii. High rate of unemployment.
 viii. Bribery / corruption.
 ix. Greed for material wealth
 x. Inadequate modern equipment to combat crime,
 xi. Delay in the delivery of justice to the offended.
 xii. The citizens lack knowledge on the procedures for the effective maintenance of law and order.
 7 x 1 = 7mks
 THE END.
